stemMd: Suppose the additional condition is: Aster must precede Dahlia. Which further statement must then be true?

options.label: C
options.textMd: Dahlia and Iris must occupy consecutive positions, in either order.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Aster must not be in position 2.

explanationMd:
First restrict attention to orders satisfying the extra condition as well as the original rules. There are 3 such orders. "Dahlia and Iris must occupy consecutive positions, in either order." holds throughout this restricted set; the other statements fail on the explicit examples in their feedback.

The remaining orders are:
- Lily → Aster → Rose → Iris → Dahlia
- Rose → Aster → Dahlia → Iris → Lily
- Rose → Aster → Lily → Iris → Dahlia

distractorRationale.b: Even with the additional condition, Lily → Aster → Rose → Iris → Dahlia is permitted and makes this statement false.
distractorRationale.d: Even with the additional condition, Lily → Aster → Rose → Iris → Dahlia is permitted and makes this statement false.
distractorRationale.a: Even with the additional condition, Lily → Aster → Rose → Iris → Dahlia is permitted and makes this statement false.
